limits: Controlled queue delay and profiling change latency; these are not ordinary speed gates.
Client-arrival gaps are not isolated GPU kernel duration.
Host elapsed calls include asynchronous submission; they are not GPU completion.
Only executing-thread CPU time is counted; other compiler/helper threads are excluded.
The first observed controlled split may have had its shape warmed earlier; report that fact.
Profiling precedes unprofiled diagnostic repeats; retain that order and observer effects.
Clock samples may miss shorter events; sample gaps and failures are retained.
